headline: FBI Links $6.3 Billion Binance Cryptocurrency Theft to North Korea
summary: The FBI has linked a record $6.3 billion cryptocurrency theft involving Binance to North Korea.
why: Binance is the largest cryptocurrency exchange globally by trading volume, and state-sponsored digital asset heists present major security and regulatory risks for digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Attribution of massive thefts highlights platform security vulnerabilities and invites heightened regulatory scrutiny.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
